posts.title: Blindsight: a Linux desktop that agents read instead of looking at
posts.description: A Linux desktop that AI agents read through the accessibility tree instead of screenshots. On 110 held-out tasks: at least as reliable, at about a third of the tokens.

posts.title: What AI assistants actually do when you ask them to book a furnace tune-up
posts.description: I asked ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to book a tune-up with a fictional Portland HVAC company and logged every request. Claude and Gemini placed a hold, ChatGPT handed me the link, a crawler booked out the week, and no assistant read llms.txt.

posts.title: A local model keeps the books
posts.description: hostel is a Mac app where a model running on your own machine keeps your books through MCP servers. The pieces, one turn's rules, and the measured numbers.
